The '''LGN-19 MagnaPulse ion drive''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] engine designed and produced by [[Farwan & Glott/Legends|Farwan & Glott]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Characteristics==
The MagnaPulse was an [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] designed by Farwan & Glott for use in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol boats]]. When the company entered into the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] market, they began marketing the MagnaPulse as a boutique engine attached to the [[FG 8T8-Twin Block2 Special]].<ref name="EV" />
